images.caption: Figure 1:The whole system: three components and one loop.Moltcomposes user agents in plain Python, vLLM rollout engines behind a request router, and a single FSDP2 policy actor on NeMo AutoModel around one Ray asynchronous queue that implements the streaming pool and partial rollout. Trajectories flow token-exactly from the engines through the queue into training, and weight refit returns over NCCL directly to the engines, bypassing the request router.
